test_title: PYST 24: SSC GD Constable 2025 - General Knowledge (Held On: 13 Feb, 2025 - Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: Basal bodies and centrioles show almost similar microscopic structures. Which of the following statements differentiates them from each other?

options.text: The centrosome contains a membrane but the basal body does not contain a membrane.
The basal bodies are protein structures while the centrosomes are not proteinaceous at all.
The centrosome has distal appendages but the basal body does not have such appendages.
Centrosomes take part in protein synthesis while basal bodies are not involved in it.

solution:
The correct answer is **__The centrosome has distal appendages but the basal body does not have such appendages__**.
